summary: Phase F1 (Foundation) backend testing complete. All 32 pytest cases pass. Verified: health endpoint envelope, JSON 404 envelope for unknown routes, UUID CHAR(36) primary keys on all 11 application tables (framework tables correctly excluded), soft_delete columns on users/roles/permissions/locales/settings, 128 permissions with {module}.{action} slug format, role permission matrix (super-admin=128, admin=97, editor=54), editor role does not have projects.delete, 2 locales with 'id' default, 15 settings, admin user seeded active/2FA-on/bcrypt $2y$, admin attached to super-admin via UUID-v7 pivot in role_user, all seeded IDs are UUID v7 (13th hex char = '7'), and seeder idempotency (re-running db:seed --force keeps counts identical). Trait/model checks verified via tinker: LogsActivity writes 'created'/'updated' rows into activity_logs with populated new_values when a Locale is created/updated; User::hasPermission('projects.delete') is true for super-admin, false for editor; User::hasPermission('projects.create') is true for editor; User::isSuperAdmin() true for admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Foundation is clean: BaseModel composes HasUuids+SoftDeletes+Blameable+LogsActivity, UUID v7 confirmed across every table (including UUID pivots which is unusual and good). ApiExceptionRenderer produces a consistent JSON envelope for 404 - verified over HTTP.

SettingSeeder produced 15 settings rows but only setting_translations has UUID PKs on its records; no translations were seeded in F1 (setting_translations is empty). Confirm this is intentional or add default id/en translations in a later phase.
Framework tables (cache/jobs/sessions/etc) intentionally keep non-UUID PKs - documented in /app/backend/README.md, not a bug.
No auth/CRUD endpoints exist yet - only /api/v1/health is registered, which matches Phase F1 scope.
test_credentials: admin@adiprimanto.com / AdiPrimanto#2026 seeded but no login endpoint exists yet (Phase F2).
seed_data_creation: None new; verified existing seeders. Created transient editor_test@adiprimanto.com and a 'tt' Locale inside tinker and force-deleted them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Foundation is solid and locked in. Phase F2 will add auth (2FA email OTP) endpoints - when that lands, add tests for login->OTP challenge->verify flow, brute-force lockout (registerFailedLogin), Sanctum PAT issuance, and CORS with credentials. Pytest file lives at /app/backend/tests/pytest/test_phase_f1_foundation.py and can be extended. MariaDB is reachable as 'mysql -u root adiprimanto_cms' (socket auth, no password) which is what the tests use.
